Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CURSOR donations_cur(p_transaction_id VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT unit_id, deferral_id 
 FROM donations
 WHERE transaction_id = p_transaction_id; 
 
 szChkDgt varchar2(3); 
 l_unit_id VARCHAR2(15); 
BEGIN

 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_INSERT_DATE := LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_LOCAL_TIME(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, :donor_consents.insert_date);
 
 IF :DONOR_CONSENTS.CONSENT_STATUS IS NULL THEN
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_CONSENT_STATUS := NULL;
 ELSIF :DONOR_CONSENTS.CONSENT_STATUS = 'A' THEN
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_CONSENT_STATUS := 'Accepted';
 ELSIF :DONOR_CONSENTS.CONSENT_STATUS = 'D' THEN
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_CONSENT_STATUS := 'Decline';
 ELSIF :DONOR_CONSENTS.CONSENT_STATUS = 'M' THEN
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_CONSENT_STATUS := 'Manual';
 END IF;

 OPEN donations_cur(:DONOR_CONSENTS.TRANSACTION_ID);
 FETCH donations_cur INTO l_unit_id, :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_DEFERRAL_ID;
 CLOSE donations_cur;
 
 IF l_unit_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 if length(l_unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(l_unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_UNIT_ID:=l_unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else
 :DONOR_CONSENTS.S_UNIT_ID:=l_unit_id;
 end if; 
 END IF;
 
END;

 synchronize;
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.d_deferral_id', displayed, property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.d_dummy_deferral_id', displayed, property_true); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.d_dummy_deferral_id', 'E');
 :CTRL_BLK_1.D_DUMMY_DEFERRAL_ID := :PARAMETER.P_DEF_ID;
 END IF;
 
 ITEM_CHANGE('DONOR_CONSENTS.PB_VIEW_CONSENT', 'D'); -- v02
 
 IF NVL(globalvar.g_clear_form,'N') = 'N' THEN -- V02; Do not query when clear form is used.

 END IF;
 
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE'); -- V02;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GO_QUERY_CONSENTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE go_query_consents IS
 CURSOR don_cur IS
 SELECT transaction_id 
 FROM donations
 WHERE (unit_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.DONATION_ID OR deferral_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.D_DEFERRAL_ID);
 
 v_where VARCHAR2(2000); 
BEGIN
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE IS NULL AND :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TO_DATE IS NULL THEN
 v_where := 'donor_id = :PARAMETER.P_DONOR_ID ';
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TO_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_where :='donor_id = :PARAMETER.P_DONOR_ID AND coll_date BETWEEN :CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE AND :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TO_DATE ';
 ELSE
 MESSAGE('ENTER FROM AND TO DATES TO RETRIEVE DONOR CONSENT FOR A SPECIFIC TIME RANGE');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 -- V01
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.DONATION_ID IS NOT NULL OR :CTRL_BLK_1.D_DEFERRAL_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TRANSACTION_ID := NULL;
 OPEN don_cur;
 FETCH don_cur INTO :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TRANSACTION_ID;
 CLOSE don_cur;
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TRANSACTION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_where := v_where || ' AND transaction_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TRANSACTION_ID';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DONOR_CONSENTS',DEFAULT_WHERE, v_where); 
 
 GO_BLOCK('DONOR_CONSENTS');
 
 COUNT_QUERY; -- IM 10102; V3
 
 
 -- IM 10102; V3
 IF globalvar.g_total_records <> 0 THEN 
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 ITEM_CHANGE('DONOR_CONSENTS.PB_VIEW_CONSENT', 'E');
 ELSE
 ITEM_CHANGE('DONOR_CONSENTS.PB_VIEW_CONSENT', 'D'); 
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE');
 DECLARE 
 timer_id Timer; 
 one_minute NUMBER(5) := 1000; 
 BEGIN 
 timer_id := CREATE_TIMER('msg_timer', one_minute, NO_REPEAT); 
 END ;
 END IF;
 
 
 /* -- IM 10102; V3 
 EXECUTE_QUERY; 
 IF :DONOR_CONSENTS.TRANSACTION_ID IS NULL THEN
 ITEM_CHANGE('DONOR_CONSENTS.PB_VIEW_CONSENT', 'D');
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.S_FROM_DATE'); -- V02
 ELSE
 ITEM_CHANGE('DONOR_CONSENTS.PB_VIEW_CONSENT', 'E');
 END IF; 
 */
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_ADDRESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_address IS
 v_flag VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT NVL (intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 INTO v_flag
 FROM donor_addresses da
 WHERE donor_id = :PARAMETER.P_DONOR_ID;
 
 IF v_flag = 'Y' THEN
 select b.intl_address_1||decode(b.intl_address_2,nvl(b.intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.intl_address_2||decode(b.intl_address_3,nvl(b.intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.intl_address_3||decode(b.intl_address_4,nvl(b.intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.intl_address_4||decode(b.country_name,nvl(b.country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(b.intl_postal_code,nvl(b.intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.D_ADDRESS
 from DONOR_ADDRESSES B
 where donor_id = :PARAMETER.P_DONOR_ID;
 ELSE
 select B.street_name||
 decode(b.suite_apt,null,', ',' #'||B.suite_apt||', ')||
 c.city||', '||c.state||' '||c.zip
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.D_ADDRESS
 from DONOR_ADDRESSES B,valid_city_state c
 where b.usps_id = c.usps_id
 and donor_id = :PARAMETER.P_DONOR_ID; 
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.D_ADDRESS := NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.D_ADDRESS := NULL; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_unit_id_format_Local(plIsbtOrCodabar in varchar2,plCodabarUnitSchme in varchar2, plUnitId in Varchar2) IS

/*********************************************************************************************************
 This procedure was created by Edwin on 05-07-2001. This is a common unit format validation 
 procedure when scanning or manual entry window is not available but unit id entry is required 
 like DRQENTRY. For ISBT, if the return value is * then the unit is correct format.
********************************************************************************************************** */ 

 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
 
 Function number_check(chk_string in varchar2) RETURN boolean IS
 temp number;
 Begin
 temp := to_number(chk_string);
 return TRUE;
 RETURN NULL; Exception
 when value_error then
 return FALSE;
 End; 

BEGIN

 IF plIsbtOrCodabar='I' then 

 if length(plUnitId) < 15 then 
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 

-- IM:8373; CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX moved to local (removed chapter ID Condition from valid_facility_identifiers.; 04/25/2012
/* if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(plUnitId,1,5)) then 
 -- clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
*/
 
 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX_LOCAL(substr(plUnitId,1,5)) then 
 -- clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 
 if not number_check(substr(plUnitId,6,8)) THEN
 --clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(plUnitId,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 

 If temp_v_out_chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 ELSE -- If codabar

 if plCodabarUnitSchme ='N' then
 if not number_check(to_number(plUnitId)) then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 if plCodabarUnitSchme ='A' then
 if length(plUnitId)!=7 then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(plUnitId,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id); 
 End if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX_LOCAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function check_isbt_prefix_local(pl_prefix in varchar2) return boolean is
 nCount varchar2(12);
 chap_id varchar2(4) := name_in('global.chapter_id');
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 select nvl(count(*), 0) 
 into nCount 
 from valid_facility_identifiers 
 where facility_identifier = pl_prefix
 --and chapter_id = chap_id -- IM:8373; Chapter ID condition is not required from DNWDFIND Screen. 04/25/2012;
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);

 if nCount > 0 then 
 return true;
 else
 return false;
 end if;

 return null; 
exception 
 when others then
 return false;
end;
